title: Endpoint feature-authority and score-signal difference
evidence: H0 populates score-progress channels using max(submission,due-date)<cutoff and summarizes them in the 49-feature branch; H1 excludes every score value.
why_it_matters: Assessment progress is direct endpoint signal. The two models do not receive semantically equivalent inputs.

title: Phase7 H1 is not an H0-plus-residual reproduction
evidence: Backbone topology, aggregate schema, preprocessing, pretraining, inner-fold count, epochs, and auxiliary weights all differ.
why_it_matters: The -0.029684 delta cannot be attributed to the residual expert alone.

title: Confirmed ranking and probability-quality deficit
why_it_matters: This rules out a threshold-only explanation and locates the deficit upstream in representation/training/features.

title: Train-time preprocessing changed materially
evidence: H0 standardizes valid sequence values with train-only masked statistics and uses median imputers; H1 feeds raw sequence values and uses nanmean/fill-zero policies.
why_it_matters: Optimization geometry and missing-value semantics differ.

title: Temporal topology and fusion input contract changed
evidence: H0 uses 24 channels, kernels [2,3], dilation 2 and compact aggregate input; H1 uses 32 channels, [2,3,5], dilation 1, 165 aggregate features plus residual expert.
why_it_matters: H1 has more parameters but is a different inductive bias; capacity count does not establish superiority.

title: Endpoint pretraining present only in H0
evidence: H0 has 15 hashed pretraining checkpoints. Its registered inner gate gain was Macro-F1 +0.001911 and PR-AUC +0.002283; H1 has none.
why_it_matters: It plausibly contributes, but the controlled historical effect is much smaller than the final 0.029684 gap.

title: Endpoint training and checkpoint recipe changed
evidence: H0 uses fixed 8 epochs and constant auxiliary weights; H1 uses NLL-selected 10/12/5 refit epochs and fold-specific early-warning hyperparameters/auxiliary weights.
why_it_matters: The H1 endpoint recipe did not preserve the historically validated H0 endpoint recipe.

title: Threshold difference is not the main cause
evidence: H1 registered Macro-F1 0.798400; even the diagnostic outer oracle is only 0.799107.
why_it_matters: Threshold changes cannot recover a 0.03 deficit.

title: Population, target, cutoff, and outer folds match
evidence: 15,378 exact record IDs, targets, cutoff days and outer-fold assignments align one-to-one.
why_it_matters: The observed final delta is real for the same held-out population, although it is not a controlled architecture-only comparison.
